About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.7% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible. 

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

About the Team

Our internship program is structured to provide interns with the opportunity to work on real projects that our customers urgently need. In this role you will be part of the Product Design team, which is made up of several groups that define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of Stripe’s product. Product Designers are strategic partners to Engineering and Product Management within their product area. In close collaboration with product teams, they shape user experiences, then translate them into high-quality designs that can be tested, shipped, and refined. Designers are responsible for building elegant, functional products that users love—and want to tell others about.

What You'll Do

As a Product Design Intern, you will focus on designing and building experiences that will be shipped to our users in production. You will contribute design iterations to ongoing project workstreams, tackling important projects to increase global commerce, and help shape brand new experiences. Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high. 

Key responsibilities include:

  • Work on a product design project with a product team, translating business ideas into real experience.
  • Help craft thoughtful experiences that enable startups and large businesses to establish and manage their businesses.
  • Apply problem-solving skills and human-centered approaches to address complex and ambiguous business and user problems.
  • Develop and refine design solutions by partnering closely with other designers.
  • Craft and prototype visually polished experiences to get user feedback. 
  • Partner closely with engineering to implement a feature/product from design to implementation, and get it in the hands of our users.
  • Engage in group design critiques and collaborative design sessions to improve and receive feedback on your work.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineers, product managers, data scientists, and researchers, proactively seeking and incorporating feedback.
  • Understand and advocate for our users, participating in the design process from early concepts to final delivery.

Who You Are

  • Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
  • Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before. 
  • Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a design-related field, such as UX/UI, Interaction Design, Human Interface, Computer Science,  HCI, or a related discipline.
  • Some experience using computer programs to design, such as Figma/Canva.
  • Demonstrated experience designing experiences and user flows.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design principles and best practices.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, form an understanding through independent research, and effectively work with a mentor and teammates.
  • Are a self-motivated problem solver committed to personal growth.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate work while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.
  • Ability to participate in a paid full-time internship between May–August, 2027. 

Preferred Qualifications (A bonus, not a requirement)

  • Previous project, internship, or work experience in UX/UI design or related fields.
  • Experience working with or conducting your own research, presenting results, and acting on those results.
  • Experience with AI tools like Cursor, Lovable, V0, or any others.
  • Strong knowledge in design craft and visual design.
  • Intent to return to the degree program after the completion of the internship/co-op.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Demo Engineering shows customers how Stripe works instead of just telling them. AI has made demos faster to build, which raises the bar on everything around the build: picking the right story, scoping it to what a customer needs to see, and keeping it current as Stripe ships. We're looking for technically fluent storytellers who know Stripe's products deeply and can turn positioning into demos that land in our most visible customer moments.

What you’ll do

You'll be the bridge between Product Marketing and the demos our field and marketing teams put in front of customers. You'll take product positioning and messaging and turn it into demo-ready narratives, then use AI-assisted tooling to get them built. You'll track product launches so our demos stay current, scope Executive Briefing Center (EBC) demos with Solutions Architects and the EBC team, curate and update our demo library, and act as the primary liaison for event content with Product Marketing.

Responsibilities

  • Translate Product Marketing positioning and messaging into demo narratives
  • Design multi-product demo stories that sequence cleanly
  • Direct demo builds using AI-assisted tools to prototype quickly and build production-quality work
  • Track Stripe product launches and keep the demo portfolio current and on-message
  • Curate the Demo Hub so the field can find the right demo for the right customer
  • Serve as the primary Product Marketing liaison for event demo content
  • Scope EBC and strategic customer demos with Solutions Architects and the EBC team

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 3+ years in a technical, customer-facing, or product role such as solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical product marketing, developer relations, or software engineering
  • Deep technical product fluency: you can explain how APIs and products fit together and judge what can be demoed reliably
  • Strong storytelling and written communication; you can turn a positioning doc into a narrative a customer will remember
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex) to prototype and build software
  • Strong judgment and taste about what matters to a customer audience, from developers to executives
  • Comfortable owning projects end to end across Product Marketing, Solutions Architects, Product, Design, and Engineering

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience as a software engineer, or experience building and integrating with Stripe or other RESTful APIs
  • Experience with online and in-person payments, subscriptions, card issuing, or other relevant concepts
  • Experience scoping or delivering executive briefings, keynotes, or large event demos
  • Experience working closely with Product Marketing on launches
  • Subject-matter expertise in a relevant industry, vertical, or product

At Breeze, we're building the AI-powered infrastructure layer for global commerce, making it radically simpler for businesses to sell, get paid, and operate across markets.

We go far beyond traditional payment processing. Breeze combines global payments, AI, stablecoins, and a Merchant of Record-like model to take on the complexity businesses typically manage themselves, including compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.

Our goal is simple: let businesses focus on building and selling great products while Breeze handles the complexity behind getting paid.

Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, Breeze is a successful, rapidly growing, and exceptionally well-capitalized company. We have the runway to think long term while remaining early enough that every person joining today can have a meaningful impact on what we build.

We are hiring an Account Manager, APAC based in Singapore!

As our Account Manager, you'll own the day-to-day relationship with a growing portfolio of APAC merchants, helping them go live smoothly and get lasting value from Breeze. This is an account management role first: you'll be the merchant's go-to contact for onboarding, account questions, business reviews, and expansion conversations. You'll also bring enough technical grounding to handle first-line integration questions, triage issues, and escalate to the appropriate teams as necessary. Reporting to our Director of Sales, APAC.

You'll work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Risk and Compliance to make sure merchants adopt Breeze quickly, stay healthy in production, and grow with us. As one of the first account management hires in Singapore, you'll help build the function from the ground up.

We're looking for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, wants meaningful ownership, and is excited to build rather than simply maintain.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day relationship with a portfolio of merchants across APAC as their primary point of contact, driving adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Take over newly signed merchants from Sales and guide them through onboarding and go-live, coordinating with our Solutions and Engineering teams where needed.
  • Handle first-line API integration questions and guide merchants through our documentation to shorten time to revenue.
  • Triage merchant issues and escalate to the respective teams (Product, Engineering, Risk, Legal, Compliance, etc.) and follow through to resolution.
  • Expand accounts by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, via regular account check-ins and business reviews covering performance, account health, and adoption of new Breeze features.
  • Track and report on retention, revenue growth, merchant satisfaction, and account health, and keep CRM records and reporting up to date.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a similar client-facing role at a fintech or technology company. Payments experience is a plus but not required.
  • Minimum conversational proficiency in Mandarin is required for this role.
  • A track record of managing a portfolio of client relationships, with the commercial instincts to grow revenue from existing accounts.
  • Basic technical foundations from working in a tech environment: you understand how APIs and webhooks work at a high level, can read an error message or API response to work out what went wrong, and know when to escalate.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with global Sales, Product, Engineering, and Risk and Compliance teams.
  • Familiarity with how online payments work, such as authorization, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement, or the curiosity to pick it up quickly.
  • Competent with AI tools in your day-to-day work, using them to research, troubleshoot, draft, and automate, and keen to keep finding new ways to apply them.
  • A clear communicator who can explain technical topics in plain language to merchants and work well with engineers internally.
  • Organized and able to manage many merchants at once, prioritizing well across day-to-day requests, issues, and growth work.
  • Proactive and resourceful, comfortable in fast-moving environments without an established playbook, and happy to get into the details yourself.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Singapore.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments, especially Merchant of Record, PSP, or cross-border commerce.
  • Exposure to crypto, stablecoin, or multi-currency payment products.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup.
  • Experience with CRM tools, BI dashboards, or basic SQL for tracking account health and looking into transaction data.
  • Other APAC languages in addition to Mandarin.

Why Breeze

  • More than payments: We're building an intelligent infrastructure layer across payments, compliance, risk, fraud, chargebacks, reconciliation, and customer support.
  • AI from the ground up: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate.
  • Successful and still early: We have meaningful traction and strong financial foundations while remaining early enough for new hires to have outsized impact.
  • Built for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.
  • Real ownership: Lean teams, few layers, direct access to decision-makers, and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Hard problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce.
  • Exceptional team: Work with ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly and care deeply about what they build.
  • Room to grow: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.

How We Work

  • Act Now, Improve Later: Ship something real today. Move fast, learn from what happens, and make it better.
  • Disagree and Commit: Debate hard before a decision. Once it's made, commit fully and make the outcome right.
  • Customers First: When in doubt, start with what's most painful for the customer.
  • Own It, End to End: Don't wait to be asked. If you see a problem, take responsibility for solving it.
  • Default to Public: Share context openly so the whole team can move faster and learn from each other.
  • High Standards, Genuine Warmth: Hold the bar high and treat people well. Be direct, rigorous, kind, and low ego.
  • Outcomes Over Activity: We care about what ships, what works, and what moves the needle, not how busy you look.
  • AI Forward, Always Learning: Experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, share what works, and continuously rethink how you can work smarter.

Compensation Philosophy

We believe compensation should be fair, competitive, consistent, and transparent. We benchmark compensation against the market and establish thoughtful bands for each role, with compensation reflecting experience, skills, location, role scope, and expected impact. We don't believe pay should primarily depend on how aggressively someone negotiates. Eligible employees receive meaningful equity, so the people building Breeze can participate in the long-term value they help create.

Benefits & Perks

  • Medical allowance: An annual allowance, prorated based on your start date, to support eligible health and wellness expenses, including health screenings, dental and vision care, insurance premiums, and eligible expenses for direct family members.
  • Corporate medical insurance: Medical coverage for full-time employees in our Singapore office, including cashless GP visits at panel clinics, specialist outpatient care with GP referral, and teleconsultations.
  • Gym & wellness: A monthly subsidy toward eligible fitness and wellness memberships, classes, and activities.
  • Productivity budget: An annual budget, prorated based on your start date, for professional development, productivity tools, books, courses, and eligible home-office improvements.
  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in the company you're helping build.
  • Equipment: A new MacBook Air and whatever else you need to do your best work.
  • Annual global offsite: We bring the global Breeze team together every year. Previous destinations include Bali and Singapore, with Japan coming next.

Benefits, allowances, and reimbursements are subject to applicable eligibility requirements, taxes, and statutory contributions. Benefits are not contractual and may be amended from time to time.

Location / Working Model

This role is in office and based in Singapore.

At Breeze, we value in-person collaboration and connection. As a lean and fast-moving startup, physical presence in the office is key to fostering teamwork and productivity, and helps us stay agile and aligned. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week, and remote work is not available for full-time employees in our Singapore office.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Why Join Breeze

  • Make an outsized impact: We're successful and still early, with meaningful traction and strong financial foundations. Lean teams, few layers, and direct access to decision-makers mean you'll have real ownership and the autonomy to make things happen.
  • Solve hard, meaningful problems: Work at the intersection of AI, payments, stablecoins, risk, compliance, financial infrastructure, and global commerce as we build an intelligent infrastructure layer that goes far beyond payments.
  • Build AI-first: AI isn't an add-on. It's central to how we're building our products and how our teams operate. You'll experiment with new tools, automate the repetitive, and continuously rethink how to work smarter.
  • Work with an exceptional team: Join ambitious, curious, low-ego people who move quickly, hold a high bar, and care deeply about what they build.
  • Grow with Breeze: As Breeze grows, strong performers can quickly expand their scope and take on bigger problems.
  • Build for the long term: Backed by Sequoia Capital, Multicoin Capital, and The Chainsmokers, we're exceptionally well-capitalized with the runway to think big.

In-Office Expectations

Employees based in our New York City, NY office follow a hybrid work model and are expected to work from the office three days per week. Employees based in our Singapore office are expected to work on-site five days per week.

In-office expectations may vary slightly depending on role, team, and business needs. Certain roles that require closer cross-functional collaboration or operational support may have additional requirements, which will be discussed during the interview process.

Our approach is designed to support meaningful in-person collaboration, team building, and real-time decision-making while providing flexibility where applicable. We believe this structure enables strong execution, close collaboration, and effective teamwork across our global offices.

Come Build With Us!

We offer a rare combination: the ownership and speed of an early-stage company with the traction, backing, and financial foundations of a successful business.

We're building at the convergence of AI, payments, stablecoins, financial infrastructure, and global commerce. The opportunity is much bigger than building another payment processor.

We're building the intelligent infrastructure layer for global commerce, and there's still an enormous amount left to build.

If you want meaningful ownership, hard problems, exceptional teammates, and the opportunity to help define what comes next, we'd love to hear from you!

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI research team, you will drive innovation in model compression and efficient deployment for advanced multimodal AI systems, including large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). Your work will focus on reducing model footprint and computational cost while preserving accuracy, enabling high-performance AI to run efficiently across resource-constrained edge devices. You will apply and advance compression techniques such as quantization, knowledge distillation, and pruning to streamline complex multimodal architectures that integrate text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in model compression methods and a strong background in multimodal model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel compression strategies that balance model size, latency, throughput, and accuracy. Your responsibilities include building robust compression pipelines, establishing performance and fidelity metrics, and addressing bottlenecks in production inference. The ultimate goal is to deliver scalable, low-memory, low-latency AI systems on edge devices (i.e., smartphones) that maintain high fidelity and tangible real-world value.

Responsibilities

  • Apply low-bit quantization to reduce model size and inference latency for generative AI models (LLMs, VLMs, multimodal) while maintaining accuracy and output quality.

  • Leverage knowledge distillation to transfer capabilities from larger teacher models to smaller student models, enabling efficient multimodal reasoning across text, image, and audio inputs.

  • Implement pruning techniques to remove redundant parameters and attention heads, reducing computational overhead without sacrificing task performance.

  • Analyze trade-offs between model efficiency (size, latency, memory) and accuracy across quantization, distillation, and pruning methods; propose improvements based on empirical findings.

  • Research and apply mixed-precision quantization and other advanced compression strategies (e.g., adaptive pruning schedules, distillation with intermediate feature matching) to optimize the accuracy–performance balance.

  • Stay current with the latest research in model compression, including emerging techniques for multimodal and generative architectures.

  • Document methodologies, experiments, and results clearly to support reproducibility, internal collaboration, and stakeholder communication.

  • Author technical papers and publish findings in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL, AAAI) to advance the field of model compression for multimodal AI.

List the qualifications, certifications, and experience needed for the role. You can split this into mandatory and preferred sections if needed.

  • A degree in Computer Science  or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Experience with PyTorch deep learning frameworks or equivalent frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with model quantization including both Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) and Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

  • Research and hands-on experience with knowledge distillation for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Research and hands-on experience with model pruning for compressing large models into smaller, efficient ones.

  • Solid understanding of neural network architectures and training processes – Including transformers (e.g., LLMs, VLMs), backpropagation, optimization, and fine-tuning techniques.

  • Familiarity with C++ is a plus (especially for implementing low-level quantization kernels or inference optimizations).

Important information for candidates

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.
